description: One voter's verdict on one parallel attempt: who voted, what they decided, the score they gave it and why. The rationale is the reason a reader opens the votes at all, so it is kept as free text and printed verbatim — the surface never parses it and never invents one. Outcome is a claim of its own: a score without a verdict (the common "grader gave 0.82") is legal and lands on Abstain. By is the optional shared identity (AgentRef): when it is set the surface paints the voter's palette slot and initials, the same identity it paints in the lanes and in the graph.

members.name: By
members.description: The voter's identity when the host has one, or null. Setting it paints the agent's palette slot, initials and (when Voter is empty) its name.

members.name: ColorToken
members.description: The palette token of the voter's identity, or an empty string when no identity is set.

members.name: DisplayName
members.description: The name a surface prints: Voter, or the identity's name when the voter is unnamed.

members.name: HasRationale
members.description: Whether the vote carries a rationale worth opening.

members.name: HasScore
members.description: Whether the vote carries a score.

members.name: Initials
members.description: The initials an avatar paints: the identity's own initials, else the initials of the vote's name.

members.name: Outcome
members.description: What the voter decided. Default Abstain, so a score-only vote is never read as an approval.

members.name: Rationale
members.description: Why the voter decided so, in the voter's own words. Empty renders no rationale, and the surface never invents one.

members.name: Score
members.description: The score the voter gave the attempt, on the host's own scale (0–1, 0–10, a percentage). null means "no score", not zero; the surface prints the number with the host's culture and never rescales it.

members.name: Voter
members.description: The voter's name as the host wants it read. Empty renders the surface's own fallback.
